outcome: Major complications during total laparoscopic hysterectomy
cohort: 504 patients who underwent total laparoscopic hysterectomy between May 2013 and May 2017
finding: There was no significant difference in the rate of major complications during total laparoscopic hysterectomy between patients with and without previous cesarean sections.
mod_finding: The study found no significant difference in major complication rates between women with and without previous cesarean sections undergoing total laparoscopic hysterectomy.
